column5: Variant: two-story house in a residential fraccionamiento in central Mexico, front facade painted, white aluminum windows, a small front garden with a young tree, a car gate in dark metal, sidewalk visible, clear morning sky; neighbors' houses barely visible at the edges.
Variant: dining room with a solid wood table for six, woven chairs, a pendant lamp in natural fiber, a sideboard low against the wall with a clay pot and fruit bowl.
Variant: shared bedroom for two children aged 6 to 9, two single beds with cotton quilts in soft colors, a small desk, a few toys put away in a basket, a reading lamp; tidy and cheerful.

Variant: family bathroom with a white vanity cabinet, a round mirror, white ceramic tiles only as a low backsplash, a small window with frosted glass, towels folded on a rack, a plant on the windowsill.

Variant: home office corner in a living space, a wood desk with a laptop (screen dark), a task lamp, an ergonomic chair, a plant, a small framed print leaned low on the desk; daylight from a side window.

Variant: covered terrace facing an interior garden, exposed concrete beams, cantera stone floor, outdoor lounge chairs with linen cushions, large potted agave and bougainvillea, warm late-afternoon light.
